forWhat: Your children in one table, and each class as a picture. A class opens topic by topic: how many children are {colour:green}, {colour:amber} or {colour:red} in each. Open a topic for its skills, and a skill for its children.
Everything here comes from checked answers only.

layout.shows: [[Class picture grid]] opens the class picture.
Search by name or Sr. No., then class, needs attention and how the table is grouped.
A row per child: how they are doing, when last seen, and notes waiting. A name opens the child.
Its tabs: [[Picture]], [[By topic]] and [[Matrix]]. [[Show as a table]] goes back to the table, on that class.

A row per topic, grouped by subject. Each row counts the children by where they stand, in words. A topic is folded until you open it. An opened topic shows its skills, and an opened skill its children, those who need you first.
How a child is counted in a topic, and what each colour means, folded away.

jobs.title: See how the class is doing in a topic
steps: Open Children and press [[Class picture grid]], then [[By topic]]. Choose another class from the table's class filter.
Each topic row counts the children: {colour:green}, {colour:amber}, {colour:red}, {colour:grey}, and not assessed yet. A child is counted once, by the skill of the topic they are weakest on.
Press the topic's name to open it. Press a skill's name to see its children.
Press the name again to fold it.

jobs.title: See how a child is doing
steps: Press the child's name in the table, or in an opened skill, or anywhere their name shows.
[[What their answers show]] is a row per topic: the level of the newest question they answered, their last paper's answers in it, their state, and their strongest or weakest skill in plain words.
Press a topic to open it: its skills, each opening to the answers behind it, and its papers.
On a paper, press [[See the child’s page]] to see what the child wrote, here on the page.
[[Repeated mistakes]] shows a mistake they make more than once. [[Report card]] and [[Parent report]] open their reports.

jobs.title: How the answers are counted
steps: Right of attempted: right answers out of those the child wrote something for.
Wrong, wrong with working, and blank are said apart. A blank is never counted as wrong.
When answers still wait to be checked, the row says so: results may change once they are checked.

jobs.title: Make a home assessment
steps: Open the child.
The panel [[Home assessment]] shows the paper the engine proposes, from the child's own answers.
Press [[See it as it will print]] to look at it. Press [[Different questions]] for others; it makes nothing.
To choose the skills and levels yourself, press [[Choose a different home assessment]].
Press [[Approve this home assessment]]. It is made and printed in your name.

jobs.title: Check and sign off a child's answers
steps: On the child's page, [[Answers to check]] lists answers waiting for a person. Press [[Right]], [[Wrong]] or [[Blank]] on each.
Answers the engine marked wait under [[Marked, waiting to be signed off]]. Press [[Sign off … as …]].
What their answers show is rebuilt straight away.

jobs.title: A skill with {colour:grey}
steps: [[Checks that would place]] lists a short check for each skill where the child has {colour:grey}.
Press [[Make this check]]. It opens the paper maker with the skill and level chosen. Nothing prints until you make it.

buttons.label: See the child’s page
buttons.does: Shows the pages the child wrote for that paper, here on the page.

buttons.label: Approve this home assessment
buttons.does: Makes and prints the home assessment you saw, in your name.

buttons.label: Different questions
buttons.does: Draws other questions to look at.

buttons.label: Sign off … as …
buttons.does: Signs off the answers the engine marked, in your name. Only signed off answers count.
buttons.doesNot: A signed off answer is never edited afterwards. A correction is added as a new one.

buttons.label: Make this check
buttons.does: Opens the paper maker with the check chosen.
